title: Client-side fetching starts after hydration
content: The browser downloads the JS, hydrates, and only then issues the request.

title: SWR revalidates on focus by default
content: Switch to another tab and back to watch it refetch.

title: Server fetching needs no CORS headers
content: Server to server requests are not subject to the browser same-origin policy.

title: Credentials cannot be hidden in the browser
content: Anything the client sends is visible in devtools.

title: Every client library ships bytes
content: SWR is small, but it is still JavaScript the user has to download.
